notes.subject: givim strongpela nek
notes.rationale: Idiom Hibru: yu givim ערף — ol birua i no save lukluk bek, ol i ranawe; literal 'nek' i stap, mining em i winim long pait

notes.subject: ערף
notes.rationale: KJV 'necks' (plural) vs ASV/JPS 'turn their backs' — yu givim nek bilong birua = birua i stat long ranewe

translation: Na ol birua bilong mi — yu givim strongpela nek bilong ol long mi; na ol i les long mi, mi katim ol i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong ol.

tokens.gloss: na ol i les long mi
mi katim ol i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong ol
